t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Basically, once you learn which gnome is passing out more mushrooms, you'll focus on that basket until it runs low and then you'll switch to the other basket. The red basket is attached to the red, brown, and purple gnome.

vb_textbox.text: The red, brown, and purple gnomes are linked to the red basket. The yellow, blue, light brown, and green gnomes are linked to the yellow basket. Figure out which basket-gnome set is giving you more mushrooms and once the count starts to run low, switch to the other basket-gnome set. You will keep switching between sets as they both start to run low and appears the forests restock.
